_doc: The pixel UI kit (story 16.14, ui/uiKit.js, ui/uiTheme.js, ui/uiIcons.js, AD-27 layers stay). Colours come from the art bible ramps (docs/ART-BIBLE.md section 1): OUT is the outline colour, `ink` panels are the slate ramp, `paper` panels (Lernbuch, Zeugnis, speech bubbles) the plaster ramp, accents are wood and hedge. A tone is { fill, inset, light, high, dark, edge, accent, shadow }: 1 base-pixel outline in `edge` with notched corners, a lit top and left bevel (`light`, corner pixel `high`), a shaded bottom and right (`dark`), a drop shadow to the bottom right, an optional accent frame. `text` gives the readable colours per tone (every pair is checked by scripts/check-uikit.mjs against `minContrast`, WCAG AA 4.5:1; `plate` is the dark HUD plate whose colours are checked over the worst case, a white world pixel). `roles` are the text styles: size in base px, colour key. `button` has the face colours of idle, selected and focused buttons and the focus ring (2 base px, 3:1 against the edge). `anim` are the open and close times in ms (eased, ignored under reducedMotion, `game.uiAnimOff` in the scripted runs).
